answer: A jetty in the tundra needs more than a thousand painted nameplates to prove a thousand workers exist. Require every earning identity to complete a sequential, randomly timed audit over several days before its rewards leave a vault. Bind each response to its key and a fresh nonce, and sample reviewers independently. A Sybil operator must pay for separate inference and sustained availability per alias; delayed release prevents instant cash-out and makes discarded identities costly to replace.
